scope: Independent static review plus read-only verification of existing seven private mock artifacts. Reviewer did not import/execute executor or mock driver, operate apps/build/lock/Chirp, or change production.

resolvedInitialFindings.title: Global regeneration can overwrite foreign maintained-patch edits
resolvedInitialFindings.detail: patch_backup captures all maintained patch files, but verify_preimages does not compare them. regen-patches.sh rewrites every manifest-owned patch. Rollback only checks seven targets/MANIFEST and protects the orphan0010 patch; other maintained patches can be overwritten without HOLD. Existing baseline patch preimages are not restored or independently verified.
resolvedInitialFindings.required: Check maintained patch images before regeneration; preserve/restore only known transaction-owned generated deltas; HOLD on unexpected images. Test both prepublish and postregen foreign patch mutation.
resolvedInitialFindings.resolution: verify_preimages and pre-regeneration checks compare maintained patch preimages; generated outputs are recorded before deferred signal delivery; final validation requires their exact bytes; rollback HOLD protects unexpected edits, orphan0010 is restored only from known images, and regen deltas need nonce-bound explicit review.

resolvedInitialFindings.title: Runtime leader exit does not prove its process group drained
resolvedInitialFindings.detail: run(runtime=True) creates an isolated session but only waits for the direct Popen leader. A descendant can remain after leader exits with cleanupVerified=true. Executor can then APPLIED and release outer lock. The selected runner checks exact agent processes but does not generally prove wrapper/build/helper descendants drained.
resolvedInitialFindings.required: Check session/process-group quiescence after direct runtime child exit; HOLD without signaling surviving processes. Mock a surviving grandchild with successful cleanup receipt.
resolvedInitialFindings.resolution: Runtime leader is waited, then a ps census drains every live non-zombie member remaining in its isolated PGID before returning. Trusted pinned v1 runner independently checks exact app/helper absence and restored profile/cache roots.

resolvedInitialFindings.title: An exception after Popen can bypass direct child drain
resolvedInitialFindings.detail: run invokes child-pid event/save before wait and has no finally drain. A postspawn bookkeeping exception can unwind to rollback while a child is still alive.
resolvedInitialFindings.required: Always drain started child in finally, including postspawn event failures. Add controlled exception mock.
resolvedInitialFindings.resolution: Popen plus child-pid event are inside try/finally; direct child wait and runtime group drain occur even when the postspawn event raises. Failure-path persistence is best effort and rollback failures retain/retry under the lock.
